description: Puts the agent threads that need you at the top, and keeps the rest out of the way until they do. A Triage sidebar sorts threads into Needs me and numbered lanes you move between with one key. Snooze hides a thread until a time you pick and brings it back unread, with an optional note for the agent. Agents call wait_for_ci and end their turn instead of polling GitHub, and are messaged when checks finish or a review arrives. PR and CI features need the GitHub CLI.
